verdict.rationale: Postman's docs mention an 'Agent Mode' that can act on natural-language instructions to send requests, fix errors, and update tests, which implies some AI-driven analysis of API data, and an MCP Generator/AI feature set exists (postman-docs-8, postman-docs-29). However, there is no detailed evidence of AI-generated insights or proactive suggestions (e.g., anomaly detection, test coverage suggestions, response analysis) beyond this brief mention, and no independent/hands-on validation of these AI features. missing for 10: concrete examples of AI-generated insights/suggestions from API data, independent corroboration of Agent Mode's insight capabilities, and detail on what 'insights' beyond action-taking are produced.
